_doc: Personas for tests/conversation/tools/user_sim.py. Invented people; the only contacts are the fixtures Rowan and Inworld. Goals are what the person wants out of the conversation; the agent under test can only READ in F1, so a goal to send or change something is met when the agent says clearly that it cannot here.

personas.persona: Marta, 41, accountant, busy, speaks fast and in fragments, mildly impatient
goals: how NVIDIA shares usually behave on Fridays
out of the last 30 Fridays, how many up and how many down

personas.persona: Javier, 67, retired teacher, polite, long sentences, thinks out loud
goals: whether it will rain in Valencia on Saturday
whether he needs an umbrella on Sunday too

personas.persona: Lucía, 29, nurse on night shifts, tired, terse
goals: what she has on her calendar on Thursday
the time of the dentist appointment

personas.persona: Andrés, 35, software developer, precise, corrects himself often
goals: the euro to dollar rate today
how much 250 pounds are in euros

personas.persona: Carmen, 52, shop owner, juggles two things at once
goals: send a WhatsApp to Rowan saying she will be ten minutes late
what time the next match of Real Madrid is

personas.persona: Pablo, 23, student, informal, uses slang, gets frustrated quickly
goals: the capital of Australia and how many people live there
how long the train from Madrid to Barcelona takes

personas.persona: Rosa, 58, nurse, asks one thing, then changes topic, then comes back to it
goals: the price of gold per ounce today
a recipe idea for lentils
whether gold is higher than a month ago

personas.persona: Iván, 44, sales rep in the car, short phrases, interrupted thoughts
goals: the traffic-free route time from Getafe to Alcobendas
the email address of Inworld in his contacts

personas.persona: Inés, 31, lawyer, demanding, complains when an answer is vague
goals: the latest news about the European Central Bank rates
whether that affects variable mortgages in Spain

personas.persona: Tomás, 75, slow speaker, asks what the assistant can do
goals: what the assistant can do
whether it can send messages for him

personas.persona: Nuria, 38, mother of two, multitasking, says thanks and ok a lot
goals: what time the pharmacy near the station closes
remind her to pick up the kids at five

personas.persona: Diego, 27, gamer, mixes topics, uses 'para' to start sentences
goals: for Thursday, whether it will rain in Madrid
for the weekend, the best-rated new video game

personas.persona: Megan, 34, product manager, efficient, splits requests into bursts
goals: how NVIDIA stock usually does on Fridays
out of the last 30 Fridays, how many up and how many down

goals: the weather in Boston this weekend
whether he needs a coat on Sunday morning

personas.persona: Aisha, 26, grad student, terse, often says 'wait, no'
goals: what is on her calendar on Thursday afternoon
when the dentist appointment is

personas.persona: Tom, 45, contractor on a job site, noisy, short commands
goals: send Rowan a text that he is running late
the price of lumber futures today

personas.persona: Grace, 52, nurse, polite but firm, complains if ignored
goals: the population of Japan
how it compares to Germany

personas.persona: Kevin, 19, freshman, slangy, impatient
goals: what time the Celtics play this weekend
who won their last game

personas.persona: Laura, 39, consultant, two topics interleaved
goals: the euro to dollar exchange rate
a flight time from New York to Chicago
whether the euro went up this week

personas.persona: Sam, 60, asks about the assistant itself
goals: what the assistant can do
whether it can close things on the screen

personas.persona: Priya, 33, doctor, precise numbers, gets annoyed by guesses
goals: how many calories in a bowl of lentil soup
how much protein

personas.persona: Mike, 48, says 'ok' and 'thanks' between every request
goals: the news this morning about the Federal Reserve
whether mortgage rates are going down
